title: Media card
description: A picture or video inside a rounded window springs in with a small turn (Motion spring); the title, a gold rule and the caption follow beside it. Give a face box for a person: the words always stay outside the window.

props.title: 2-6 words beside the window
props.caption: one or two lines
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture, if a person is in it
props.side: left (default) or right: where the window goes
props.poster: still shown before a video loads

example.title: AI Mentor Jay
example.caption: AI education for everyone.
example.alt: AI Mentor Jay at his desk, speaking into a microphone
